stages.success: input and evaluation contracts, dev tables including failures
unchanged admission and loss results or explicit unsupported result
two ratios and all seeds, parent and identity checks
candidate or null and full policy decisions
all frozen references and selected candidates including failed results
calculation and model qualification reported separately

budget.skab_optional_structure: K1 only if press K1 admitted

K1.gate: fit gate AND both conditional vibration residuals and B1/C1 scores finite
K1.baseline_cal: all real normal cal with finite B1 scores
K1.route: conditional iff g=1 and conditional cal supported, otherwise exact B1
K1.guaranteed_contract: g=0 and finite/alpha-supported B1 implies identical score, p and decision; common unsupported wrapper otherwise
K1.nonfinite_baseline_query: unsupported with quality request before rank computation

selection.augmented_normal_order: exact integer sum across training seeds divided by 3

skab.interval_estimator: median of fit-group medians of positive timestamp differences
skab.calibration_weighting: one equal weight per pooled real normal cal block
skab.label_interval: row min/max observed anomaly; block max lower/max upper; missing or invalid row=(0,1)
skab.primary_metrics: unambiguous conflict-free blocks plus full-block bounds
skab.events: nonconflicting 0-to-1 onset and contiguous 1 run within same continuous segment
skab.late_detection: separate through first completed block after event
group_aggregation: equal group mean with available denominators and exclusions
skab.external_improvement_claim: no group normal-rate worsening, no lost confirmed event, no common-event latency worsening, at least one strict improvement; undefined required comparison means not_established

normal_label_exception.basis: pinned data/README normal-mode description; never overrides overlapping conflicting annotation

skab.right_censored_event: known onset eligible for detection by observation-end; report separately from completed events; not eternal missed fault
skab.left_censored_or_ambiguous_onset: exclude from new-onset recall, retain counts and observed reaction
skab.K1_mapping: use G/C scores and SKAB current-level gate; no press sinusoid gate

augmentation.allocation: balanced among eligible real-fit parents, fixed allocation permutation, no redistribution of failures
augmentation.eligible_parent: at least one candidate crop length strictly less than parent length
augmentation.rng: NumPy PCG64, SHA256 compact ensure_ascii JSON([normal_crop,fold,parent_key,seed]) first 8 bytes little-endian
augmentation.length_sampling: uniform over lengths with unselected legal starts
augmentation.A1: full original copies on the corresponding successful A2 parent allocation
augmentation.scaling: real fit only; transform children using child length
augmentation.parent_neighbor_rule: minimum reference distance per distinct parent, exclude query parent and all children, mean nearest 5 parents
augmentation.seed_crossing: full 3 training x 3 injection product; same perturbation across training seeds

policy.raw_model_selection_unit: one threshold decision per completed record
policy.P23_start: current bit=1 and >=2 positives in last at most 3 valid bits; may trigger on second bit
policy.unsupported: immediate quality ticket; close mechanical unknown; reset history
policy.finite_quality_flag: keep mechanical and quality reasons; at most one new ticket at timestamp
policy.quality_ticket_duration: not invented; one ticket at quality decision
policy.normal_occupancy: intersection with intervals whose current block is definitely normal; possible-normal upper includes ambiguous labels; calendar proxy only

future_injections.existing_development_and_loss: unchanged design_v1, including fit-only scales and all-parent conservative POD
future_injections.unsupported_nonzero: keep full parent denominator, detection=0; supported-only supplementary

T1.windows: nonoverlapping from evaluation start independently for each L
T1.replay: one changed window in original full stream per scenario
T1.start: first sample of second changed record

H1.fit_tone: one maximum normalized-mean-power frequency per vibration channel, lowest-frequency tie
H1.shape: demeaned seeded-phase sine normalized RMS, existing fit-only reference scale

H2.preserves: AC RMS and Fourier magnitudes, not peak
H2.expected_RMS_only_model_behavior: invariant score, report negative control rather than new sensitivity
H2.numerical_boundary: preserve raw prediction, do not count within-tolerance score jitter crossing a tie as new phase sensitivity

future_injections.heldout_rng: compact ensure_ascii JSON([heldout,P2,parent_key,H1,target,frequency_string,seed]) SHA256 first 8 bytes little-endian -> PCG64; frequency_string in 0.10/0.25/0.40; amplitude excluded

probability.K1_input: fit-only sC if g else sB, never cal-derived p or cal-dependent route
probability.optimizer_failure: explicit failure, not successful calibrated probability
probability.primary_claim: 100% evaluation support and both q-weighted Brier and log loss strictly better than constant q at q=0.1
probability.missing_head_score: exclude with reason, recompute n0/n1 and declared q weights
probability.missing_evaluation_probability: null with full denominator and class coverage; supported-only losses on same subset; no overall gain claim unless 100% support

beihang.scope: optional secondary condition evidence, never press reselection
beihang.anchor: common overlap start for each file
beihang.boundary_purge: one window index floor(boundary-t0) at each 60%/80% boundary; whole-role windows only
beihang.interval_fit: channel-specific median positive interval from first 60%
beihang.features: log AC RMS each vibration, log abs median speed, log speed MAD
beihang.condition: positive speed within fit 1%-99%, degree1 ridge .001, >=30 trimmed parents
beihang.test: Healthy state/2.csv plus nine wear files
beihang.speed_bins: fit quartiles, merge equal boundaries; outside separate
beihang.common_overlap: max channel first times to min channel last times
beihang.paired_empty_cells: exclude only the empty time/value pair as padding with count; one-sided empty is input error; never whole-row dropna

freeze_test_models_SKAB: K1 only if press K1 admitted

input_quality.parse_time_conflict_nonfinite: fail affected capture numeric evaluation; preserve rows and incomplete denominators
input_quality.exact_duplicate: deduplicate only equal timestamp and all numeric sensors
input_quality.short_finite_record: partial features or abstain, never drop
input_quality.press_flat: n>=2 and an exactly constant channel, keep other finite score
